method: Recursive whole-finding comparison, retaining list order, every non-identity value and bijective identity references; only authenticated publication-version fields differ. Navigation abstract-N IDs are scoped to their actual _Engine instance: the main producer/consumer engine and each separately constructed counterexample engine.

abstract_identity_scope_source.basis: analyze_navigation_contracts constructs one _Engine for producer/consumer, then a fresh _Engine inside each counterexample selector iteration; value() allocates abstract-N from self.counter.
